moat_against: No profitable year ever: negative owner's earnings 5 of 5 years, per-share losses widening
SBC exceeds revenue ($312M FY2025, $450M TTM); share count compounding +12.3%/yr
Competing architectures backed by IBM/Google/Honeywell R&D budgets dwarf IonQ's
Commercial-scale quantum advantage unproven; revenue is systems sales and government programs, not recurring high-margin cloud economics
moat_for: Trapped-ion architecture with high gate fidelity and published error-correction roadmap
First-mover commercial revenue among quantum pure plays; record Q2 2026 revenue and $485M remaining performance obligations
Vertical integration via SkyWater fab and Oxford Ionics acquisitions
moat_justification: Trapped-ion technology lead is real but unproven as an economic moat: operating income and owner's earnings are negative in every filed year (FY2025 operating loss -$633.7M on $130.0M revenue), so ROIC is deeply negative through the whole history with no through-cycle evidence of pricing power; IBM, Google, Honeywell/Quantinuum and other pure plays contest the field with far larger R&D budgets.
name: IonQ, Inc.
one_liner: Pre-profit quantum pure play, moat 2/10 — negative owner's earnings in 5 of 5 years and -$2.57/share TTM with SBC exceeding revenue; no OE base exists, so it cannot clear 15% at any price on this method.
